{{Quote|Don't worry, there are plenty of places to hide out. You don't have to go planetside.''"<br />"''What'd you have in mind?''"<br />"''Maybe the Mataou fuel station&hellip; they'd never look for you there.|Solomahal and Covah|<ref name="GG" />}}
The '''Mataou fuel station''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Mataou/Legends|Mataou]],<ref name="GG" /> which was situated in the [[Mataou system/Legends|Mataou system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was a part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA Mataou" /> The [[Space station/Legends|station]] circled Mataou at a safe distance above its dangerous [[Desert/Legends|desert]] surface and served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="GG" />

At one point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]],<ref name="GG" /> a drifter and freelance [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the [[YV-888 freighter]] ''[[QuadStar]]'',<ref name="Rough">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325adv|text=Rough and Tundra|int=Rough and Tundra}}</ref> agreed to transport the fugitive [[Covah]] off<ref name="GG" /> the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Tatooine">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}} describes [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]] and [[Covah]] departing [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], which {{DB|location|tatooine|Tatooine}} establishes to have been a [[City/Legends|settlement]] on the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].</ref> and into hiding from the Empire. As the ''QuadStar'' was departing Tatooine, Solomahal and Covah discussed possible locations in the Greater Javin at which the latter could hide, with the former suggesting the Mataou fuel station as an option and claiming that the Imperials would "never" look for the fugitive there.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mataou fuel station was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Mataou [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the station, in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA Mataou" />
